description: This file defines a PHP class representing search filter parameters for employee language data within an HR management system. It extends a base filter class and specifies allowed sorting fields and a property for employee number filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee allowed language records based on employee number and sortable fields within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value, accepting null or an integer.
